fields.value: Owned-SSH session with an unknown create reply waits forever and keeps the machine busy

Found by MTG-183's operator, 2026-10-25 (etude-sdk 0.2.2 controller on Jack Heart's laptop, pool mini).

Observed: launch a21e8bcb7116 on owned machine 'mini' (SSH mini-heart.local). At 14:53 UTC the session start failed transiently: 'machine create: create reply unknown; reconciling existing request; Unreachable: SSH or the remote session command failed'. Session 8d186a917829 stayed claimed, receipt/started/refused/ended all null, startup_deadline null, for 6.5 h. Cancelling the run did not end it (the cancel check runs only before create). Every later launch to the pool failed with "cannot launch on 'mini': it is busy; etude queue would wait". There is no CLI to end it (terminate is for rented machines only).

Workaround used: with the controller stopped, store.record_refusal(session) and fail_before_start(attempt, 'capacity_refused').

Expected: an owned SSH machine has no rental to rediscover, so a failed or unanswered start should be retried or refused, after a bounded startup deadline at the latest; and a cancel should end an unstarted session.

Also seen: the controller's loop had stalled since 05:18 UTC ('etude controller' showed 'last loop: 05:18 UTC') while its process stayed alive under launchd KeepAlive; a kickstart fixed it. Possibly related (a blocking storage/SSH call without a timeout). The last stderr line was a [storage.read](<http://storage.read>) TimeoutError retry at 03:44 UTC.
